_comment: Element catalog shared by the web editor (tools/map-editor) and the codegen (tools/gen_maps.py). Adding a new placeable element here teaches BOTH the editor and the build about it. The engine's own rendering of a new decal kind / wallpaper style is still hand-coded in raycast.c; this file is the editor+format+codegen boundary.

cells._doc: grid glyph -> engine world_map cell value

palette.label: Void exit (border opening — walk out into the expanse)

facing._doc: spawn cardinal -> engine angle (0..255). dir=(cos,sin) of angle*360/256; +Y is south. So 0=E(+X) 64=S(+Y) 128=W(-X) 192=N(-Y). Verified vs fixed_map spawn (192, opens north).

partition._doc: free-standing wallpaper divider: a line segment with decor enums

crawl._doc: low-ceiling run -> ceil_h_add_run(cx,cy,dx,dy,len). dir gives dx,dy.

decals._doc: wall-mounted fixed elements. face -> axis (N/S walls run along X => axis 1; E/W walls run along Y => axis 0). z is plate-centre height [0..1]. ADD A NEW WALL ELEMENT BY ADDING AN ENTRY HERE (give it the next kind number).

assets._doc: Render catalog for sprite/decal ASSETS — the single source of truth the codegen turns into the engine's data-driven sprite_defs[] table (tools/gen_assets.py -> sh_src/sprite_defs.h) AND that export_assets.py reads to build the editor preview. 'kind' matches decals.kinds. mount='wall' is painted flat into the wall column (outlet/door — fixed to a wall, can't float); mount='billboard' is a camera-facing free-standing standup (neanderthal, and future stop-sign/lightpost). 'decode' names the stored-value -> palette strategy shared by the bake tool + engine ('offset' = 0 transparent, v>0 -> base+v-1; 'door' = the multi-ramp dlut). 'sym' is the C array symbol in the _tex.h; WIDTH/HEIGHT macros are upper(sym)+_WIDTH/_HEIGHT. Adding a sprite here + its _tex.h teaches the build, the preview and the renderer about it with no C edits.

light._doc: ceiling light fixture placed per-cell in the editor's Lights layer (the bright fluorescent panel + its 3x3 cell_light pool). The engine auto-derives lights today, so authored lights are editor/preview-only until per-map light support lands in the ROM.

roles._doc: Map roles. 'protected' = canonical (lives in maps/core/, the editor clones on edit, CODEOWNERS-gated in PRs). 'picker' = appears in the in-game start-menu picker + pause MAPS tab. 'priority' orders custom_maps[] (lower first) so pickable maps sort before the lobby and the engine just bounds the picker on custom_pick_count. 'folder' is where the role lives.

limits._doc: must match the engine caps; the codegen rejects maps that exceed these. max_dim tracks the ENGINE grid (raycast.h MAP_W/H) — 64x64 was tried and reverted (too sparse to walk), so authored maps cap at 32 until the engine grid grows again.
